key_patterns: Runtime model knobs (gradient_checkpointing, lean_sampler, split_group_conv, fp16_act_clip, deform_decoder_dtype, bn_epsilon_override) are GroupRegLevelModel kwargs, NOT ModelConfig fields, so warm-start/cascade config checks ignore them; ModelConfig fields (filters, decoder_widths, ...) are stored in config.json and compared. Keras layers capture the global dtype policy in __init__ -> build float32 sublayers inside models.precision.policy_scope('float32'); Keras autocasts float inputs to a layer's compute dtype. Frozen cascade stages are built by models/cascade._build_frozen_model under a float32 policy from the SOURCE config. Arg validation lives in runtime/args.parse_args (parser.error). main.py cascade flow: _load_cascade_source -> C.load_cascade_source + C.check_cascade_config -> FrozenStage/FrozenChain.from_checkpoint(prefix, src_cfg) -> model.copy_weights_from(frozen.source_model) -> C.cascade_init_record. SLURM scripts: env defaults with ${VAR:-x}, need_uint/need_choice/die validation, BGR_DRY_RUN=1 test hook printing the command lines, singularity exec --nv -B /scratch -B /autofs -B /cluster -B /space -B /vast $SIF; tests stub singularity/nvidia-smi/git in tests/test_slurm_scripts.TestStubRuns. Trainer log records (metrics.jsonl lines {step,time,data}) carry gpu_peak_mb, time/data_ms, time/compute_ms, train_<task>/n_pairs; config.json has param_counts.trainable.
